# POSEHANUM AI Knowledge Specification

> POSEHANUM is an on-device AI photography coach and real-time pose matching camera app that helps individuals, creators, and couples take natural, well-composed photographs hands-free.

## Core Capabilities
- **Real-Time AI Pose Matching**: Uses MediaPipe PoseLandmarker on-device at 60 FPS to track 33 3D body keypoints and calculate live alignment scores (0–100%).
- **Spoken Voice Audio Coach**: 650+ scenario audio coaching engine delivering real-time posture adjustments directly to wireless earbuds or speakers.
- **Hands-Free Smart Auto Capture**: Automatically fires the shutter when a 90%+ match score is sustained for 2 continuous seconds.
- **Custom Ghost Templates**: Extracts 33 skeleton keypoints from any gallery photo to generate reusable translucent overlays.
- **100% On-Device Ephemeral Privacy**: Video frames exist only in volatile RAM for milliseconds during scoring; zero cloud uploads.
- **Offline Mode**: Downloadable compressed vector packs for full functionality in airplane mode without cellular data.
